Privacy Policy

Welcome to TechTroveSell.

Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices available to you when visiting our website.

Information We Collect

We may collect:

  • Information you voluntarily provide through contact forms or email.
  • Anonymous usage data such as browser type, device information, pages visited, and time spent on our website.
  • Cookies and similar technologies used to improve website performance.

We do not sell your personal information.

How We Use Your Information

We use collected information to:

  • Improve our website and content.
  • Respond to inquiries.
  • Analyze website traffic.
  • Detect technical issues.
  • Improve user experience.

Cookies

TechTroveSell uses cookies to:

  • Remember preferences.
  • Measure website traffic.
  • Improve website performance.
  • Support affiliate tracking where applicable.

You can disable cookies through your browser settings.

Google Analytics

We may use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use our website. Google Analytics collects anonymous information such as pages viewed, session duration, browser type, and approximate location.

Affiliate Links

Some articles contain affiliate links. If you purchase through these links, we may earn a commission at no additional cost to you.

These commissions help support TechTroveSell and do not influence our editorial opinions.

Third-Party Websites

Our website may link to third-party websites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices or content.

Data Security

We implement reasonable security measures to protect our website. However, no online system can guarantee complete security.

Children’s Privacy

TechTroveSell is not intended for children under 13 years of age.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes become effective immediately after publication.
